description:
In this video, I’m comparing five different ways to finish or refinish stairs: sanding and staining builder-grade wood, installing veneered tread caps, using solid hardwood treads and risers, installing vinyl stair treads, and finishing stairs with tile.  If you found this video helpful, please subscribe. Cheers! Watch all of my product comparisons 👉🏼https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL34cQkzKfXWbPHit6sG9uSpU8u2D_i_q-

I’ll show you how each system works, what tools you need, how difficult each option is to install, and what you can expect to spend per step.

If you’re trying to refinish an old staircase, there are more options than simply sanding and staining the existing wood.

We’ll compare stair refinishing options that range from roughly $20 to $100 per step, including:

Sand and stain
Veneered tread caps
Solid hardwood treads and risers
Vinyl stair treads
Tile stairs
